hypothesis: Filtering retrieved candidates that contradict explicit tender constraints before LLM reranking will reduce unsafe positive matches and improve hard-pass coverage.
plan_summary: Created and strictly validated OpenSpec change with proposal, capability spec, design, and implementable focused-test tasks. It introduces tri-state compatibility gating, observable diagnostics, explicit out-of-scope abstention, and extractor failure fallback.
expected_effect: Exclude known-incompatible candidates, abstain safely for explicit out-of-scope queries or exhausted compatible pools, and retain fail-open behavior for uncertain extraction.
expected_metric_gain: Estimated +3–10 percentage points public hard-pass and +3–7 points blind hard-pass, with reduced human-reject risk.
lesson_from_history: No prior cycles exist. Baseline evidence favors safety-aware candidate selection over retrieval tuning because no unresolved cases are proven retrieval misses.
candidate_hypotheses: Constraint-aware pre-rerank candidate gating with safe fallback (selected).
Legacy/designation alias mapping for vendor and Soviet valve codes.
Index-time catalog text enrichment and hybrid retrieval/fusion tuning.
Schema expansion for flange subtype, temperature, and pipe-OD semantics.

plan_summary: Created and validated proposal, spec, design, and implementation-only tasks under openspec/changes/cycle-02-compatibility-evidence-reranking/.
expected_effect: Reranker sees satisfied, contradictory, and unverified requirements while retaining every retrieved candidate.
expected_metric_gain: +3–10 pp public and +3–7 pp blind hard-pass; lower wrong-product/human-reject risk.
lesson_from_history: Cycle 1’s fail-closed candidate gate regressed public and blind coverage, so this change neither filters nor reorders candidates and fails open on extraction errors.
candidate_hypotheses: Schema expansion for flange, temperature, and pipe-OD semantics.
Index-time catalog enrichment and RRF tuning.

expected_effect: Retrieve using the original query plus at most one safe canonical representation, deduplicate candidates per modality before RRF, and retain the original query for reranking and output.
expected_metric_gain: +3–10 pp public hard-pass and +3–7 pp blind hard-pass, with no intended false-match increase.
lesson_from_history: Cycle 1’s candidate filtering regressed public/blind coverage, and Cycle 2’s reranker compatibility evidence regressed public safety. This proposal changes only query-time candidate recall, preserves candidate decision semantics, and fails open to original retrieval.
